name: structured-software-lifecycle

plugins.name: structured-software-lifecycle
plugins.description: Structured, technology-agnostic method to run a software project end to end: scoping, specification, data model, API, architecture, planning, risk analysis and iterative development with living documentation.

plugins.name: emil-design-skills
